name: Your Berlin Street in 1928
place: Your own address · c. 1928 and today
alt: Example personalised aerial print: a Berlin square in 1928 and today
storyHtml:
Type your address and see your street from above in 1928, the way a survey plane photographed it, with the same spot today below it. Most Berlin Altbau blocks were already standing, so you can often find your own courtyard. If your house is newer, you see what stood there before it.

The print carries your street, district, map coordinates and an optional line of your own.
storyHtmlDigital: The digital version of my print: your own Berlin spot in the 1928 aerial photograph, with the same spot today below it, at the same scale, and your title, area line and coordinates.

name: Berolina — Modernist
alt: Berolina with her city-wall crown, outstretched hand and Berlin bear shield against a red circle and black geometric forms, shown in full.
visualCreditsHtml:
Statue reference: Berolina at Alexanderplatz, circa 1900. Photographer unknown; Wikimedia Commons marks the photograph as public domain. Statue by Emil Hundrieser. The photograph was used as a reference for the pose and identifying details; this print is an artistic interpretation.

Original reference photograph · Public Domain Mark

Room images and video are 3D styling visualizations made in Blender using Poly Haven models and textures, CC0. They show the 30 x 40 cm version; frames, furniture and decor are not included.
